name: scpiml-device-development
description: Create, extend, debug, and test Karabo middlelayer instrument devices built with scpiml. Requires the karabo-device-development plugin.

interface.shortDescription: Build and test instrument devices with scpiml.
interface.longDescription: Guidance for mapping instrument protocols to scpiml descriptors, channels, reply handlers, connection behavior, and simulated hardware tests. Covers creating, extending, and debugging downstream devices. Requires karabo-device-development for shared Karabo middlelayer and pytest guidance.
interface.defaultPrompt: Create, extend, debug, or test this scpiml instrument device using its protocol documentation and the Karabo development guidance.
